description.ja: プラグインの v1 ルートの台帳（ADR-009 D4）。プラグインごとのルートは作らず、ここにある固定のルートだけ。path は Flask の書き方（AutonaApiV1 の blueprint は /api/v1）、endpoint は src/core/WebAccess.py の ROUTE_ACCESS のキー、access はその区分の値（this_pc / shell）。一覧とアイコンだけが THIS_PC、ほかは全部 SHELL（no-store・ApiCatalog に載せない・ヘッドレスは 403）。stage はそのルートが入る段階（D10）。配線の PR が ROUTE_ACCESS と blueprint のルールをこれと突き合わせる。<plugin_id> はドットを含むので、inputs / dev / actions / uploads / installs / listing の固定の語と重ならない。
description.en: The ledger of the plugin v1 routes (ADR-009 D4). No route per plugin: only the fixed routes below. path is in Flask's notation (AutonaApiV1's blueprint is /api/v1), endpoint the key of src/core/WebAccess.py ROUTE_ACCESS, access its class value (this_pc / shell). Only the list and the icon are THIS_PC; every other route is SHELL (no-store, not in ApiCatalog, 403 headless). stage is the stage the route arrives in (D10). The wiring PRs hold ROUTE_ACCESS and the blueprint's rules to this. A <plugin_id> holds a dot, so it never collides with the fixed words inputs / dev / actions / uploads / installs / listing.

envelope.ok: {"ok": true, "data": <answer>} (null when a route answers nothing); a route whose answer is raw: ... sends that body itself (no envelope)
envelope.error: {"ok": false, "error": {"code", "message", "reason"}}: code the v1 code of the status, reason the refusal (contract_1.json refusals), message its detail -- for busy the whole seconds left (rounded up) when known, e.g. "42"; never a path, a value or a secret
envelope.body_note: A body is JSON. A key the body does not name stays as it is; a value of the wrong type, an unknown key or an unknown pick id is invalid_request.

types.PluginDetail: the ListEntry fields plus: description (text, optional), reason (text | null: the state's reason in words), homepage (boolean: the manifest has one), funding (boolean), permissions (the manifest's B.2 object), settings (the manifest's field array), setting_values ({key: SettingValue} for every setting key), jobs (the manifest's jobs: id, title, lane, timeout_seconds, manual, params, actions, hooks)
types.SettingValue: {kind: "value", value} | {kind: "secret", set: boolean} | {kind: "pick", name: string | null} (a file / folder setting: its name only, never the path)
types.SettingsBody: {values: {key: value | pick id | null}}: a file / folder value is a pick id; null removes the saved value (back to the default); a secret key is invalid_request (it has its own route)
types.SecretBody: {value: string} (contract_1.json field_types secret); the answer never holds it
types.InputChoice: {id, label}: id is what RunBody.inputs names (contract_1.json field_types source[].choice_id); label is the host's words
types.RunBody: {job, trigger: {kind: "manual", target: null} | {kind: "action", target}, params: {key: value | pick id}, inputs: {source key: choice id}}: a source key left out (or null) is not picked -- fine when the field is optional; state is never named; an action's own file is the page's context, not a choice
types.DevState: {enabled: boolean, folders: [{id, name, from_env}]}: id contract_1.json patterns.dev_folder_id, name the folder's name (never the path), from_env true for a folder from AUTONA_PLUGIN_DEV (the page offers no remove for it)
types.UploadAnswer: {upload_id, expires_in_sec}: upload_id a secret token the install names (cut in the op log); held expires_in_sec seconds, one at a time (a new upload replaces it)
types.InstallBody: {upload_id} (P5a); {listing_id} (P5b) and {update: plugin_id} (P6) answer unavailable until their stage
types.InstallStatus: {install_id, state: contract_1.json install.states, plugin_id: string | null (once prepared), sheet: ConsentSheet | null (once prepared; kept through installing / done), error: InstallFailure | null}: preparing -> consent -> installing -> done; failed / cancelled end it. A consent refused because a run of the plugin goes returns to consent with error.reason busy (press again)
types.ConsentSheet: {id, version, name (text), author, license, description (text | null), homepage (boolean), source: {kind: contract_1.json install.source_kinds, name: string | null (owner/repo, github only)}, verified (boolean: the zip matched its repository's release descriptor), sha256, zip_bytes, size_bytes (unpacked), decision (update | confirm_same_or_older | new_install | refuse_dev_id | refuse_reserved), needs_consent (boolean), installed_version (string | null), consent_digest (sent back by the consent), permissions (the manifest's B.2 object), settings (the manifest's field array), jobs (as PluginDetail's)}. Never a path
types.InstallFailure: {reason: contract_1.json refusals reason, code: contract_1.json install.errors key, problems: [zip_problems / manifest check codes / describe's failure], detail: words without a path or a value}
types.ConsentBody: {consent_digest}: the shown sheet's (a different one is invalid_request: the page consents to what it showed)
types.RemovalInfo: {state: contract_1.json install.removal_states, error: InstallFailure | null (the last removal's), data_bytes (user_data/plugins/<id>/data/), runs (the job folders), runs_bytes, out_bytes (their out/ folders: what runs=keep_out keeps), work_folder: string | null (the work folder's name, never its path)}
types.RemoveBody: {data: boolean (remove data_dir), runs: delete | keep_out | keep}

pick_answer: pickFile / pickFolder (purpose plugin) answer {ok: true, status: "picked", id, name}: id the pick id the bodies send, name the picked file's or folder's name to show (never the path); {ok: true, status: "cancelled"} when the dialog was closed (nothing held); {ok: false, error} when refused

routes.purpose: The list: id, name, author, version, state, badge, size_bytes, has_icon only (contract_1.json plugin_list). No reason text, error, path or history.
The manifest's icon: png signature and 256 KiB checked, Content-Type image/png, nosniff. 404 without one.

The detail: the manifest's form (jobs, fields), the settings (secrets as set / not set only; a file / folder value by its name only, never the path), the state's reasons, the declarations and the data passed, homepage / funding present.

Save non-secret settings (config.json). A file / folder value is a pick id (pickFile / pickFolder); the host resolves it to the absolute path and stores that. 400 invalid_request when a value does not fit.
A dev folder's reload: read the manifest again and run describe.
The manual choices of a source type: match_log (dates and tournaments) in P2; result_image (the newest 30) and thumbnail_image from P3. state has no choices.

Start a job: {job, trigger: {kind: manual | action, target}, params (a file / folder value is a pick id), inputs (choice ids per source key)}. The host adds the settings. 409 busy / needs_settings / blocked / disabled / incompatible / job_unusable, 400 invalid_request.
The plugin's past runs (the newest 20 kept), newest first.
A run (contract_1.json job_record); the page polls it every second while running.
Ask a run to stop (cancel line, close stdin, 10 s grace, then the job object).
The end of the run's worker.log (unknown stdout lines and stderr).

routes.answer: raw: the artifact kind's content_type (contract_1.json artifacts.kinds)
routes.purpose: An accepted artifact by its index (0-based) in the run's artifacts, checked again; fixed Content-Type, nosniff. The page fetches an image into a blob URL.
Open the folder of an artifact (file / json) in Explorer.
The developer toggle and the dev folders (dev.json and AUTONA_PLUGIN_DEV).
Turn the developer toggle on / off (the page confirms first).
Add a dev folder from a pickFolder pick id (the page confirms first). 409 id_taken when an installed plugin has its id.
Remove a dev folder (by its stable id, contract_1.json patterns.dev_folder_id) from the list; the folder is not touched.
The actions of a target (?target=result_image | thumbnail_image | archive_export) for the pages' 'Plugins' menu, with the form of each job.
Save a secret setting (DPAPI). The answer never holds the value.
Clear a secret setting.

Upload a plugin zip: its bytes as the body (not multipart), Content-Length required and at most limits.zip_max_bytes -- a missing or a larger one is invalid_request (400), refused before a byte is read. 201.
Drop an uploaded zip not installed (gone all the same when installed, replaced or expired: not a 404).

Start an install: {upload_id} (P5a), {listing_id} (P5b), {update: plugin_id} (P6). A job expands the zip to .new, checks it and reads plugin.json (state preparing, 202); poll GET for the consent sheet. One install at a time (busy); a new one declines a sheet still waiting. The upload is taken (404 when unknown or expired).
An install's progress and its consent sheet (the page polls it while preparing / installing).
Consent (state consent only): a job runs describe in .new, swaps, records install.json, then scans the list and refreshes the hooks (state installing, 202). busy while a run of the plugin goes.
Decline or cancel an install: .new is removed (preparing: when its job ends). busy while installing; an ended install is answered as it is.
Enable an installed plugin (contract_1.json manifest_paths.enabled). The built-in and a dev plugin are invalid_request.

Disable an installed plugin: saved first, then its running jobs are cancelled; its pending hooks are dropped when they would start (a start planned before the save is refused). busy while it is being removed or installed (its commit). The built-in and a dev plugin are invalid_request.

What a removal would remove (the sizes of data_dir, the job folders and their out/, the work folder's name) and the removal's state (the page polls it while removing: the sizes are the last ones then, not read again). A removal that failed after the plugin left the list (a partial removal) is still answered, failed, and can be asked again; 404 only when the plugin is gone and no removal is known (a removal that ended well).

Remove an installed plugin (a job, 202): its starts held, its running jobs cancelled and waited for, its hooks forgotten (removed), its folder, secrets.bin (always), data_dir and job folders as asked removed, then the list scanned and the hooks refreshed, then the hold given back. Answers state removing with the last-known sizes. busy while it is being removed, installed (its commit) or enabled; also accepted for a plugin that left the list after a failed removal.
The listing ('Browse'): plugins.json's listed rows (plugin, template, tool), read from GitHub and copied to _listing.json.
Check for updates (6 hours since the last check, or forced by the button).
The plugin's hooks: enabled, saved values, pending, counts, failures, the disable reason and the history (20 each; the last failed run's run_id for its log).
Enable / disable a hook with the values it runs with: {enabled, params} (a file / folder value is a pick id). Desktop only.
A dev plugin only: run the hook once with the golden input (not counted).

shell_verbs.answer: purpose plugin: pick_answer; purpose assets: the game assets' answer ({ok, status, pick, name, games, conflicts, expiresInSec}, for POST /api/v1/assets:importFolder)
shell_verbs.purpose: A folder for a folder field or a dev folder to add (purpose plugin), or a game folder to import (purpose assets, the existing use); the page never names a folder.

args.extensions: the file field's extensions joined by commas: each patterns.file_extension (lower case, no dot), at most patterns.file_extensions_max

shell_verbs.purpose: A file for a file field, filtered by its extensions; the page gets a pick id and the file's name (pick_answer), never the path (as pickFolder).

args.id: a plugin id or a listing row's id

shell_verbs.purpose: {source: installed | listing, id, link: homepage | funding | repo}: the host builds the https URL and opens the default browser; the page passes no URL.
